hub.title: Connect your Milesight gateway
hub.description: Enter the MQTT topic your gateway publishes uplinks to (Milesight gateway: Network Server > Applications > Data Transmission > MQTT). New devices will then appear automatically under Discovered.

data_description.payload_encoding: How the gateway encodes the raw payload in the 'data' field (Base64 is the Milesight default).
data_description.downlink_topic: Used to switch WS wall switches and sockets. {deveui} is replaced by the device's DevEUI (Milesight gateway: set the downlink topic to e.g. milesight/downlink/$deveui).
data_description.downlink_format: Milesight gateway JSON (confirmed / fPort / data) or ChirpStack v4 (adds devEui).
data_description.extra_topics: Optional, comma separated, wildcards allowed. Point the gateway's ACK Notification, Join Notification and Gateway Information MQTT topics here (e.g. milesight/ack, milesight/join, milesight/gateway) – or ChirpStack gateway/+/event/stats, application/+/device/+/event/ack.
data_description.gateway_offline_min: A gateway is shown offline when it has forwarded nothing (and sent no status report) for this long.

data_description.deveui: 16 hex characters, printed on the device label.
data_description.area: Room / area name – created if it doesn't exist.

confirm.title: New LoRaWAN device found
confirm.description:
DevEUI **{deveui}** is sending data.

Detected model: **{guess}** (possible: {candidates}). Check the model on the device label and give it a name, e.g. the room or door it monitors.

data.empty_grace_min: Count as empty after (minutes at 0 people)
data.auto_backfill: Fetch stored data after an outage

data_description.max_gap_min: Time is not counted across gaps longer than this, so an offline sensor doesn't add phantom open/occupied time. Set it above the device's reporting interval.
data_description.model: Change this if the wrong model was picked. Entities from the old model can then be deleted from the device page.
data_description.co2_limit: Time above this level is counted as 'CO2 above limit'. 1000 ppm is a common indoor guideline.
data_description.install_height_mm: Distance the sensor measures when the bin / tank is empty (sensor to bottom). Used to calculate the fill level %. 0 = off.
data_description.run_threshold_a: The load counts as running while the current (any channel) is at or above this. Used for running time and start counts.
data_description.mains_voltage: Phase voltage, e.g. 230. Enables the 'Estimated power' sensors (current × voltage, apparent power in VA). 0 = off.
data_description.downlink_topic: Used to switch WS wall switches and sockets. {deveui} is replaced by the device's DevEUI (Milesight gateway: set the downlink topic to e.g. milesight/downlink/$deveui).
data_description.downlink_format: Milesight gateway JSON (confirmed / fPort / data) or ChirpStack v4 (adds devEui).
data_description.battery_low_pct: The 'Battery low' sensor turns on below this level.
data_description.meter_type: Turn the pulse counter into a water / gas / electricity meter for the Energy dashboard.
data_description.meter_pulses_per_unit: e.g. 1 pulse per litre with unit L = 1; 100 pulses per m³ = 100.
data_description.meter_offset: Reading of the physical meter when counting started, so Home Assistant shows the same number.
data_description.meter_source: Leave empty (pulse_count / gpio_counter_1). For a second UC counter enter e.g. gpio_counter_2.
data_description.auto_backfill: When the device comes back after a gap, ask it to resend what it stored and fill the history graphs.
data_description.extra_topics: Optional, comma separated, wildcards allowed. Point the gateway's ACK Notification, Join Notification and Gateway Information MQTT topics here (e.g. milesight/ack, milesight/join, milesight/gateway) – or ChirpStack gateway/+/event/stats, application/+/device/+/event/ack.
data_description.gateway_offline_min: A gateway is shown offline when it has forwarded nothing (and sent no status report) for this long.
data_description.confirmed_downlinks: Ask the device to acknowledge every downlink (LoRaWAN confirmed). Needs the gateway's ACK notification topic under the gateway's settings. Uses a little more airtime.
data_description.downlink_retries: Commands the device does not answer within two uplinks are sent again this many times, then marked failed. 0 = never retry.
data_description.display_max_bytes: Text blocks are packed into downlinks of at most this size. 51 works at every EU868 data rate; raise it (up to 222) for displays close to a gateway, lower it to 11 for US915 SF10.

send_downlink.name: Send downlink
send_downlink.description: Send raw bytes to a device through the gateway (advanced).

output_command.name: Output command
output_command.description: Switch an output or valve, optionally for a limited time (UC controllers, GS101).

output.name: Output
output.description: Output key, e.g. gpio_output_1, valve_1, valve_1_opening.

action.name: Action
action.description: on, off, on_for / off_for (UC300, value in ms), open_for (UC511/512 seconds, UC521 minutes), open_until_pulses, set (UC521 opening %).

value.name: Value
value.description: Duration, pulse count or opening % depending on the action.

display_content.name: Display content
display_content.description: Send text and a QR code to DS3604 e-ink displays. Blocks match the template layout set in Milesight ToolBox; leave a block out to keep it.

show.name: Show template
show.description: Switch the display to this template.

refresh.name: Refresh display
refresh.description: Force a full screen refresh afterwards.

beep.name: Beep
beep.description: Beep once when the content arrives.

content.name: Content
content.description: All blocks at once as a mapping, e.g. {text_1: Room 1, text_2: Free, qrcode: https://…}. Empty values are skipped.

force.name: Send unchanged blocks
force.description: Also send blocks that already show this text (normally skipped to save battery and airtime).
